value.rationale: The two conflicting automaton objectives are a central subject of the 2019/2022 literature. A single forbidden-factor family gives an arbitrarily large **maximal** ordinary-minimum colex width r+1 yet allows full Wheeler sortability at exactly r extra states. Uniform lower bounds quantify the unavoidable prefix-indexing storage cost, rather than an arbitrary isolated enumeration. The simultaneous infinite-family exact profile and explicit canonical interval split are useful in state minimization and text indexing.
